description: Payment Receipt Check — 0.02 USD per call, synchronous. Synchronous check of an already-made agent payment ($0.02 per call). Flags double charge, over/under charge, settle without response, failed-but-onchain settle, fake RLUSD, partial payment, wrong destination/tag. On warn/critical the response CTAs to Wrong-Buy Remediation $49. Retry with the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is not charged twice. Pay in USDC on Base via x402, or RLUSD/XRP on XRPL via x402 (XRP priced at quote time, DestinationTag required).
name: receipt_check
